tabs.html:
UniFi UAP-AC-M | High-Performance Mesh Wi-Fi 5 Access Point for Indoor & Outdoor Use

Compact, indoor/outdoor WiFi 5 AP with 4 spatial streams and optional external antenna support for directional coverage.
Seamless Mesh Wi-Fi Expansion with UniFi UAP-AC-M

The UniFi UAP-AC-M is a high-performance, dual-band 802.11ac Mesh Access Point, designed for indoor and outdoor Wi-Fi coverage. With 2×2 MIMO technology and speeds up to 1167 Mbps, this compact yet powerful access point ensures seamless connectivity across homes, offices, retail spaces, and large outdoor areas. It features two RP-SMA connectors for flexible antenna options, allowing you to customize coverage with either included omni-directional antennas or optional dual-band antennas.

Key Features:

  • High-Speed Mesh Wi-Fi – 802.11ac dual-band with speeds up to 1167 Mbps (2.4 GHz: 300 Mbps | 5 GHz: 867 Mbps)
  • Powerful 2×2 MIMO Technology – Delivers fast, stable, and interference-free Wi-Fi
  • Flexible Deployment – Mount on walls, poles, or fast-mount brackets (all included)
  • Outdoor-Ready & Durable – Designed to withstand harsh weather conditions (-30°C to 70°C)
  • Customizable Antenna Options – Features RP-SMA connectors for external antenna support
  • Enterprise-Grade Security – Supports WEP, WPA-PSK, WPA-Enterprise (WPA/WPA2, TKIP/AES)
  • Mesh Networking – Expands coverage effortlessly with UniFi Mesh Technology

Technical Specifications:
  • Networking Interface: 1× Gigabit Ethernet (GbE) port
  • Wi-Fi Standard: 802.11a/b/g/n/ac
  • Max. Clients: 100+ devices
  • Coverage Area: 140 m² (1,500 ft²)
  • Power Supply: 24V Passive PoE (Gigabit PoE adapter included)
  • Power Consumption: 8.5W Max
  • Antenna Gain: 2.4 GHz: 3 dBi | 5 GHz: 4 dBi
  • Operating Temperature: -30°C to 70°C (-22°F to 158°F)
  • Certifications: CE, FCC, IC, UKCA

What’s in the Box?

  • 1x UniFi UAP-AC-M Access Point
  • 2x Dual-Band Omni Antennas
  • 1x Gigabit PoE Adapter (24V, 0.5A)
  • 1x Mounting Kit (Wall/Pole/Fast-Mount)

Why Choose UniFi UAP-AC-M?

  • Easy Management – Monitor and configure your network via the UniFi Network Application
  • Remote Firmware Updates – Upgrade your devices anywhere, anytime
  • Guest Wi-Fi & Hotspot Customization – Control user access, privacy settings, and network traffic
  • Scalable Solution – Ideal for homes, businesses, and outdoor areas needing seamless, high-speed Wi-Fi
